# Linear System Numeric

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Integrate a two-state linear system with x′ = v, v′ = 0, x(0) = 1 and v(0) = 2. Each output row contains position and velocity at its sample time.

## What this example demonstrates

Integrate a two-state linear system with x′ = v, v′ = 0, x(0) = 1 and v(0) = 2. Each output row contains position and velocity at its sample time.
